Oliver — thanks and congrats on the close. Received the MAP and I scanned the milestones. Quick confirmations and next steps below.

Planned canary approach (high level):
- Canary week: 2027-06-14 through 2027-06-18 (proposed).
- Cohort: 50 internal users (Clinical Ops + Integrations team).
- Evaluation plan: we will run a controlled workload for peak windows and capture latency P50/P95, token-cost delta, and end-to-end success ratios vs expected prompts. All — I updated Oliver's MAP with three discrete rollout phases and a concise evaluation plan. See notes below and I attached the updated agenda and evaluation rubric.

Rollout phases (summary):
1) Canary (internal pilot) — 2027-06-14 to 2027-06-18
   - Goals: verify latency/SLOs, KV-cache behavior under session affinity, prompt performance on clinical templates.
   - Success metrics: pass all acceptance thresholds in the first 24 hours and no critical regressions across 24-hour windows.
2) Limited external pilot — 2027-06-28 to 2027-07-02
   - Select 5 external clinics for shadow/dual-write testing.
3) Full ramp — starting 2027-07-12 over 4 weeks with progressive traffic growth.

Evaluation plan highlights:
- Priya will run nightly evals on the 120 prompt set and publish a short daily digest (Slack + shared Drive).
- We will sample 500 inference calls per day during canary and run automated reranking/regression checks.
- Rollback trigger: any sustained P95 > 1200ms for four hours or quality regression > 12% vs baseline across eval set.

Training: proposed two half-day sessions — 2027-06-09 & 2027-06-10, 9am–12pm PST. Oliver, confirm attendee lists and we will send calendar invites.

Attachments: training_agenda_v2.docx, updated_MAP_notes.txt (inline comments in the spreadsheet).
